title: Net Metering by State Comparison 2026 for American Homeowners
excerpt: Learn about net metering laws and regulations in your state when installing solar panels for your home.
content:
Net Metering Overview

Net metering is a policy that allows homeowners with solar panels to generate and store excess energy for later use, reducing their utility bills.

State Comparison

Each state in the US has its own net metering laws and regulations. Here's a brief comparison:

Arizona: 12 years of grandfathered rates, then moves to a new rate plan after that.

California: Solar customers are currently grandfathered in until January 2024, with a new rate plan to take effect.

Florida: 20 years of guaranteed net metering rates for new customers.

Net Metering Laws by State

For a complete and up-to-date list of net metering laws by state, visit the Database of State Incentives for Renewables & Efficiency (DSIRE).

Conclusion

Net metering laws vary significantly by state, impacting the financial feasibility of solar panels for homeowners. Visit SolarAtlas to find solar data for your city.
